differences.subject: sun_rays
differences.description: The sun has twelve rays in the left panel and nineteen in the right panel.

differences.subject: playground_flag
differences.description: The waving flag above the playground roof is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: sky_clouds
differences.description: There are two clouds in the left panel and three in the right panel.

differences.subject: tree_flowers
differences.description: Four flower shapes appear in the tree canopy in the right panel.

differences.subject: left_fence_picket
differences.description: The leftmost fence picket changes from a rounded top to a pointed top.

differences.subject: playground_railing_bars
differences.description: The railing above the climbing wall has five internal vertical bars on the left and four on the right.

differences.subject: lower_playground_window
differences.description: The lower playground opening changes from a circle to an arched opening.

differences.subject: rocking_horse_tail
differences.description: An inner curved line appears inside the rocking horse tail.

differences.subject: center_flower
differences.description: The middle flower changes from a round daisy to a tulip.

differences.subject: boy_shirt
differences.description: The boy shirt changes from a star design to horizontal stripes.

differences.subject: skyline_building
differences.description: The pale blue rectangular building left of the tallest tower is taller in the right panel.

differences.subject: dog_toy
differences.description: The toy beside the dog changes from yellow to red.

differences.subject: small_left_cactus
differences.description: The small cactus at the far left foreground is absent from the right panel.

differences.subject: sky_birds
differences.description: Three birds appear in the sky to the right of the tallest cactus.

differences.subject: small_sky_cloud
differences.description: A small isolated white cloud appears to the left of the tallest cactus.

differences.subject: middle_cactus_right_arm
differences.description: The right arm of the middle branched cactus extends higher in the right panel.

differences.subject: upper_left_flower_sprig
differences.description: The small flower sprig above and to the right of the upper-left flower cluster is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: lower_left_flower
differences.description: The flower entering from the lower-left edge changes from orange to yellow.

differences.subject: lower_right_flower_sprig
differences.description: A separate small flower sprig appears near the lower-right corner.

differences.subject: curled_brown_petal
differences.description: The brown curled petal below the net reverses orientation.

differences.subject: upper_atomium_sphere_left_window
differences.description: The leftmost window on the uppermost Atomium sphere is absent in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: left_atomium_sphere_left_window
differences.description: The leftmost window on the large left Atomium sphere is absent in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: top_wall_brick
differences.from: extends left beyond the brick column
differences.description: The top red brick no longer protrudes to the left of the brick column.

differences.subject: upper_wall_vertical_mortar_line
differences.description: A vertical yellow mortar line in the upper brick column is absent, joining two red bricks into one.

differences.subject: right_facade_decoration
differences.from: right red square and shorter horizontal red rectangle
differences.description: The right red square beneath the balcony is replaced by an extension of the horizontal red rectangle.

differences.subject: orange_shirt_woman_hand
differences.from: left hand and forearm visible beside the curtain
differences.to: left hand and forearm hidden behind the curtain
differences.description: The gray-haired woman left hand and forearm are hidden behind the curtain in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: green_jacket_person_hand
differences.to: right hand partly hidden behind the building
differences.description: Part of the green-jacket person right hand is hidden by the building in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: red_shirt_child_shoe
differences.from: rear shoe visible beside the orange slab
differences.to: rear shoe hidden behind the orange slab
differences.description: The red-shirt child rear shoe is hidden behind the orange slab in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: upper_flower_cluster
differences.description: The orange flowers in the upper planter are absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: right_planter_seedling
differences.description: An extra seedling appears toward the right end of the large rectangular planter.

differences.subject: bench_leg
differences.description: The slanting bench leg at the lower left changes from red to green.

differences.subject: garden_trowel_handle
differences.description: The wooden trowel handle at the bottom has more closely spaced ridges in the right panel.

differences.subject: cutting_board_handle
differences.description: The round hanging hole in the cutting board handle disappears.

differences.subject: upper_grape
differences.description: A single grape appears above the board near its handle.

differences.subject: cheese_knife_handle
differences.description: The horizontal cheese knife handle changes from orange brown to dark gray brown.

differences.subject: lower_left_wine
differences.description: The wine in the lower-left glass changes from pink red to pale yellow.

differences.subject: loose_almond
differences.description: The loose almond beside the white cheese wedge is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: upper_bear_shape
differences.description: The bear-shaped piece near the top changes from blue to green.

differences.subject: crescent_shaped_object
differences.description: The pale blue crescent changes from opening left to opening right.

differences.subject: small_yellow_bead
differences.description: One of the two small yellow beads below the scissors is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: long_blue_needle
differences.description: The long thin blue needle beside the lower blue tape roll is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: top_left_yellow_sprinkle
differences.description: The loose yellow sprinkle just below and to the left of the upper-left doughnut is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: upper_right_red_sprinkle
differences.description: A red sprinkle appears on the empty surface above and to the right of the wooden scoop.

differences.subject: wooden_scoop_handle
differences.description: The printed text on the wooden scoop handle disappears.

differences.subject: bottom_right_donut_sprinkles
differences.description: The green sprinkles on the lower-right chocolate doughnut change to blue.

differences.subject: middle_closed_beach_umbrella
differences.description: The slender closed beach umbrella near the middle of the beach is absent in the right panel.

differences.subject: striped_beach_umbrella
differences.description: The large striped beach umbrella changes from blue stripes to brown stripes.

differences.subject: upper_left_lounge_chair
differences.description: The upper-left lounge chair changes from orange to yellow.

differences.subject: distant_island
differences.description: An additional distant island appears at the far right of the horizon.
